spans.s:
n. (-वं)
Grandeur, wealth.
E.
विभव, and अण् added.

n. (-त्रं)
Apportioning, dividing.
E.
विभाजयितृ one who makes a division or causes it to be made, अञ् aff., and the semivowel rejected.

n. (-भ्रं)
The heaven of VIṢṆU.
E.
वि variously, भ्राज् to shine, ड aff., and अण् added.

n. (-जं)
A garden of the gods, a celestial grove or garden.
E.
वि variously, भ्राज to shine, aff. अच्, and अण् added.
